cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Withdraw the Objection
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to drop a complaint, challenge, or special request and accept the official process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Drop the demand to question our delivery driver. The missing-parcel claim goes through this form. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your form requires a photo of the parcel I haven't received.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Use a photo of your empty doorstep. That's the delivery location.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you stand in it holding today's newspaper?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, beside the doormat. Put me under 'supporting evidence,' and leave the driver off your witness list.

mechanism: A steers a missing-parcel claimant into the official form, adapts photographic evidence and personally participates to get the driver demand dropped.
confusable: Unlike granting the special investigation, A helps within the process while explicitly keeping the requested witness outside it.
comparison: A form evidence workaround differs from acknowledging a donor within a common tea queue.
seedUse: D180-a missing parcel photo, empty doorstep and newspaper; S02-a accepts the actual evidence-support task.
